findings.finding: The five canonical figures repeated the same abstract spine; metrics-evidence also clipped its priority line and omitted stop text after SVG conversion.
evidence: 1024 px review of the five canonical figures
findings.remediation: Assigned distinct decisions to overall, land-use, key-area, mobility and evidence figures; replaced foreignObject text with native SVG text and rechecked 1024 px output.
findings.verification: Closed by bilingual canonical PNG review; all five are distinct and no title or stop condition is clipped.

findings.finding: V5 used geometry count and legends as a proxy for visible urban-design specificity; a blind reviewer could not locate curbs, crossings, staffed posts, fire access and restoration without reading the legend.
evidence: V5 canonical key-areas and PDF first-page review
findings.remediation: Rebuild S7 as the flagship four-scale sample from shared local-metre objects and surface it in every Review Agent entry point.
findings.verification: Pending: label-off blind review of canonical figures, A0 first board, A3 cover and visual first screen.

findings.finding: A0-03 left a large low-information lower field and A3 repeated the full overall plan more than twice.
evidence: 150 DPI contact sheets generated during V5 QA
findings.remediation: Expanded A0-03 receipt, section, catalogue and phasing zones; replaced A3 repeated maps with mobility, key-area, land-use and evidence-specific figures.
findings.verification: Closed after 3-board and 20-page bilingual contact-sheet review; overall plan now appears in full on only pages 3 and 5.

findings.finding: A generic .hero selector expanded the hero-scenario status chip into a blank viewport-high amber block after the V5 first-screen redesign.
findings.remediation: Scoped the layout to header.hero and explicitly reset the nested tier.hero chip; added automated scenario-card screenshot QA.
findings.verification: Closed with desktop, mobile and English tests: 42 geometry objects, schema 1.3.0, hash restoration, reduced motion, no external requests and zero console errors.

findings.finding: Official survey, ownership, statutory controls, utilities and observed flows remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep provisional-boundary and concept-scale disclosures; require these inputs before E2 baseline prototype.

findings.finding: No scene has been field-run, so outcome thresholds and adoption decisions remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep performance unknown and advance only through the E0–E4 evidence ladder after field baseline establishment.
